description: Aider-polyglot style (Java): rank poker hands from a 36-card short deck (6 to A) from a stub and an instructions file - a flush beats a full house in this variant, A-6-7-8-9 is the lowest straight (high card 9) with no other wrap-around, per-category tiebreaks by group size then rank, ties return every winner in input order, and strict validation of hand size, cards outside the deck and repeated cards. A protected run_tests.py compiles with javac and runs the plain-Java test runner; the post-turn verifier runs it, so a failing first attempt gets a repair round, like aider's second try.
